description:
From the fz-kdt.107 step-3 review (2026-09-01): fz-kdt.118's drop
rule runs only WITHIN a question group (callsite_dispatch.rs:~452),
so refining an axis (119 tuples, 107.3 lists) splits groups and
LOSES the drop -- measured: the un-dropped narrow arms are the +6-9%
native code growth on enum_map_family/00277 and leave permanently
unreachable-in-practice arms lowered. Generalize the drop to: same
callee AND test contained AND surface contained (the 118 theorem
holds -- a value passing the narrow test also passes the wide one,
and surface containment makes the wide body complete for it).
Re-measure the growth back out; re-run 118's gates. Sequence after
107.3 (its numbers are the acceptance baseline).
title: unroutable_alternatives should judge test-containment, not question-equality
